notes.title: Update 1.1.4b - HAVE FUN!!!
notes.content: New animations added, after death the restart performance increased, Story failure fixed! HAVE FUN!!!!

notes.title: ENOSIS v002b update notes
notes.content:
The following has been changed or added:

New inventory system

New trading system

More weapons

Some enemies have been improved

Some enemies simply didn't spawn, so this has been fixed

Samaritan NPC not spawning has been added permanently (if the player dies and they are nearby, they heal them)

Crystal Grove scroll fixed

Dragon fixed

Meteorite shower fixed

Elves and rogue hunters fixed

Samira (Elven Hunter) added a new sync and gave her more personality.

Storage system revised.
